values.subject: Antai Insurance：Quote for one-day group personal accident insurance for 44 people
values.body_text: Insurance is arranged for 44 people, for one day, including the factory tour, with a total premium of 1,760 yuan; an invoice made out to the company can be issued. To purchase the insurance, only the headcount and event date are required; individual identification details are not needed. The deadline is one business day before coverage takes effect.
